model_review.current_revision_includes: Section 15.1 now attributes the 413-header inventory to the project technical inventory dated 14.09.2026, performed by the orchestrator, not to the author. This is the only source-text change in this revision. All earlier author additions in 17.3 and the methodological plan are preserved; the current adapter conversion result was not added.
model_review.artifact_binding_scope: The complete extracted final reader text was read semantically in order after rebuilding. Markdown source, notebook and HTML are bound to their final hashes; no separate full semantic read of their serializations is asserted.

full_sequential_semantic_read.statement: All 635 lines were read semantically in contiguous order after the provenance correction and rebuild: 23 Markdown cells, six captions and alt texts, equations, tables, headings and bibliography. Extracted text matches concatenated Markdown-cell sources apart from boundary whitespace.

scientific_headings.statement: Headings name the scientific objects, methods, evidence boundaries and planned stages. Sections 15.1 and 17.8 distinguish available historical images, absent independent reference masks and future processing.

technical_terminology_and_scope.statement: Reviewed whole-heart versus chamber quantities; geometry versus electrical fitting; radius versus independent center depth; SliceThickness versus ImagePositionPatient spacing; contrast-administration metadata versus image contrast quality; automatic volumes versus reference errors. No new concrete terminology error was found.

derived_analytical_object_definitions.statement: Definitions, inputs, units and comparison roles were read throughout. The added paired-error equation defines TS and reference volumes for the same region and phase, the two states, e(t) and delta(Delta V), in mL. Its following explanatory paragraph identifies the variables. The affine-volume relation in 17.3 is explicitly limited to continuous geometry.

direct_classification_and_meaningful_con.statement: Meaningful distinctions are preserved: predicted volume versus unknown error; technical pilot phases versus ED/ES; conditional analysis on automatic masks versus anatomical validation; direct sensitivity versus inverse identifiability of a target function. Missing manual references do not block the authorized exploratory work.

idiom_cohesion_and_evidence_boundaries.statement: The full Russian prose was assessed for grammar, idiom, referents, headings, transitions and claim scope. Project technical inventory performed by the orchestrator, author confirmation that reference masks are absent, planned computations and unperformed validation remain distinct. Sources and external data were not rechecked during this pass.

caption_review.scope_note: All six captions and alt texts were read in sequence with the surrounding text. PNG layout and physical interpretation were not separately reviewed in this language pass.

language_review.basis: No new concrete language or reader-facing coherence issue was found after a fresh complete sequential read of all 635 lines, 23 Markdown cells and six captions following the final provenance correction. This status applies only to text and captions.

methodological_scope_note: Independent reference masks are absent by author confirmation. Automatic V and Delta V and conditional geometric-candidate analysis may proceed; quantitative reference error is not yet available. A later reference must be independent of TotalSegmentator. Existing 39 phase results are reused. No FEM, physical or clinical validation status is upgraded.

new_formula_review.scope: No formula changed in this revision. All existing formulas were read in sequence, including the paired volume error in 15.1 and the continuous-geometry volume relation in 17.3.
